fields.statement: At f82e440f, go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(change-workflow-pin|describe-golden)$' passes. The change-workflow-pin testscript pins a draft change set with rhiza change workflow docs. Then change show --json shows "workflow": "docs" and run start --dry-run prints '- Workflow: docs'. --clear returns previous=docs, after which change show has no workflow and run start --dry-run falls back to the dispatch rules. The script refuses an unknown name ('no such workflow'), a name together with --clear, no name at all, and a landed change set ('landed'). Each stage passes fold-ok. go test -run TestChangeWorkflow ./internal/api passes; it covers the change.workflow operation's refusals (exit 2), dry run, pin, clear and the landed refusal (exit 3). internal/changeset, entry, store and render all pass, including the format-5 pin corpus. I read the diff: the pin entry is format 5, the fold applies it only in flight, and the operation refuses a live run through refuseLiveRun. The full internal/api run failed only on things this change does not touch: the driver poll idle CPU budget (5.7ms over 5ms on the shared host) and the existing .rhiza-root/usage.live.json leak check from the run-start tests.
